== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Tartarus is a [[Territory]] that serves as a source of power for certain [[Travelers]]. Those who draw from this realm, known as [[Tartarus Travelers]], are often characterized as soldiers due to their disciplined nature and tendency to follow orders. These individuals typically wear gleaming [[steel]] armor and utilize silver keys to open [[Gates]], through which they summon various metallic objects such as spinning blades, needles, tornadoes of glass, and razor-edged metal beasts. The realm is also associated with a unique, nearly unbreakable material known as [[Tartarus steel]], which is used to forge massive weapons like war-hammers and swords. Beyond individual [[Travelers]], the name refers to powerful entities including a massive, ten-foot armored giant and an [[Incarnation]] that possesses immense strength and durability. Additionally, Tartarus is linked to a specific Grandmaster and an Overlord named [[Cyrus]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Tartarus is a silver-key [[Territory]] that remains standing as a location where honor holds no value. This entity exists as a specific type of [[Traveler]] that guards can summon at will. Within this realm, specialized armor was once forged. Furthermore, the name also refers to a collective group of men and women who wear armored uniforms.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Tartarus is one of the nine Territories and a Grandmaster that contains a [[labyrinth|Labyrinth]]. This ten-foot giant is an [[Incarnation]] clad in mirrored [[steel]] armor, featuring a helmeted head with blank clockwork eyes made of twisting bronze gears. He possesses a voice like grinding rocks and wields a solid, shining red sword marked with twisting black lettering, which he once swung at [[Kai]]'s neck. While three women behind [[Grandmaster Naraka]] wear his armor and the [[Elysian Incarnation]] has recruited thirty-seven of his [[Travelers]], Tartarus commands a team capable of subduing [[Leah]]. Ultimately, he was defeated and his pieces were dragged away.}}
